completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Unattended permanent protection needs actual recognized recipients and future management without hidden omniscience.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Permanent repeated casts,partial removal and suppression can regenerate consumed layers or create unlimited duplicate defenses.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: retained distinct source records with explicit nonstacking function arbitration and component-specific permanent removal. B: a chosen parcel-replacement policy with complete affected occupants and cleanup.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on spatial overlap and recasts; do not invent a site cap as though printed. completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Protects against ALL HARMFUL EFFECTS for24HOURS; CoreAction120ft/V,S,M-or-F does not give target or area.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A as disclosed target completion unless intended site semantics choose B. Preserve full24hours and actual broad protective benefit. No reduction to resistance,one condition,finite pool or a single death-prevention use. Consent applies at real selection; a mixed beneficial/harmful ongoing effect requires a selected component policy.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Harm needs an exhaustive implementable native rule across damage,conditions,control,resource loss,body changes,direct death and environment.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: source-owned event classification of detrimental incoming consequences with explicit mixed-effect and consent rules. B: a different complete native harmful-operation predicate.

Protection from a harmful consequence does not automatically remove a wall,unlock a door or create oxygen/food. Do not retroactively cure existing harm or restore spent actions.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: All harmful effects conflicts with explicit bypasses,post-defense transferred damage,unpreventable death and removal of the ward itself.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: narrowly chosen precedence between actual absolute clauses,with preserved unavoidable costs and source-specific transfer stages. B: newly selected ultimate overrides named individually with explicit consequences.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer because ordinary mitigation immunity cannot decide every absolute conflict. Does this source prevent a post-defense transfer that expressly skips prevention,or respect it? Is ending this ward a harmful effect it prevents itself,or an admitted removal interface? Does it protect underlying0HP/dead states or only new effects? Provide useful positive protection against direct hostile death if selected,not a DeathWard floor substitute. Hunt/cosmology exceptions are not automatically overwritten by an ordinary ward.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Existing ongoing harm,suppression,expiry and recasting can produce retroactive cures or replayed damage.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: prevent new admitted consequences and suppress eligible ongoing expressions while clocks continue,without erasing original sources. B: explicit cure/removal modes only as separately authored additions.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with actual event boundaries. A prior Wound,HP loss,failed death save or lost concentration is not silently undone. If suppressed harmful control resumes at ward expiry,use its remaining actual lifetime and current source rules,not reset duration or delayed unpaid damage. Select same-name arbitration and legal voluntary ending,including save/load,world time and exploration/combat transitions. Neither elapsed real menu time nor a new scene restarts24hours.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: 20FT SPHERE with SEVENLAYERS OF PROTECTION; CoreAction/range20/Instantaneous has no radius/diameter distinction,lifetime or concentration.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: explicitly choose20ft radius versus diameter,center within20ft,and a finite live duration/concentration. B: another fully specified protective enclosure.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must select exact3D closed sphere,not a flat ring. Preserve all seven layers throughout the chosen lifetime unless legitimately removed; do not collapse them into a single AC bonus or invent instantaneous seven damage blasts.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Seven layers are not assigned native protection categories,colors or offensive damage/banishment riders.
completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.options: A: seven explicitly NEW native defensive functions with complete independently addressable states. B: a different justified seven-layer package preserving distinct meaningful protection.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Traversal in either direction and removing one or many layers lack order and success predicates.

completeOriginalQuestionsUnchanged.exactSourceOrConflict: Partial suppression,layer destruction,refreshing casts and overlapping spheres need persistent source ownership.

focusedAdditionalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A permanent site suite and seven protective layers require distinct positive behavior and durable ownership, not merely barrier geometry or rejected unsupported functions.
focusedAdditionalQuestions.request: Return complete newly selected native function profiles with one working example for every function/layer, all actual action/cost/recipient/geometry/ending details, and real current actors/objects. Demonstrate ten full minutes of Eternal Ward creation with a genuine interrupted branch, ownership/editing after caster absence, a moved or damaged site and removed-function persistence. For Prismatic Sphere preserve closed geometry and each layer through partial suppression, occupied return and actual source-qualified removal without external color puzzles or automatic regeneration.

originalQuestions.options: A: retain exact Core access,casting,range and components; complete only identified gaps. B: individually justified source correction with original preserved.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Reflect ALL SPELLS BACK AT CASTER for1minute; CoreAction120ft/V/S/F does not name ward recipient or concentration.

originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A as a disclosed target completion,retaining minute and unlimited eligible events. Ordinary SpellTurning is still pending and its capacity/level ceiling cannot silently limit this greater spell. No added one-per-round cap,Reaction cost or charge depletion. Select replacement/overlap by actual cast owner without multiplying reflected payloads.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: All spells does not define beneficial/self spells,area or multi-target effects,continuous fields,object/summon attacks or ownerless sources.
originalQuestions.options: A: reflect each eligible spell application attempting to affect the protected recipient while other original recipients remain their own branches. B: reflect the entire generating spell with complete relocation/multiple-recipient rules.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on the substantive scope; A is not authority to omit area/save spells or recurring magical exposure. Classify actual spells versus subsequent creature weapon attacks and independent mundane consequences from their sources. Choose benefit/consent behavior before outcomes; arbitrary post-roll opt-out is not implied. Specify whether a current friendly buff is already established or is a new incoming application. Preserve a useful return effect for every admitted branch and disclose any genuine exclusions.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Back at caster needs exact new recipient/area geometry,attack/save snapshot,hostile predicate and source ownership.
originalQuestions.options: A: source-qualified redirection retaining original casting owner/rank/DC and paid history. B: a newly authored distinct reflection actor and full corresponding ownership rules.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with explicit branch mapping. Establish returned-target range/line-of-effect,actual enemy/self eligibility,area origin and miss/invalid/dead/departed caster outcomes. Do not silently redirect a whole area onto all bystanders or grant a generic safe target override. Original warded branch must remain protected even when the return cannot lawfully affect its caster unless a separately justified rule selects otherwise. Reflected casts do not create learned spells,capture permissions,second RP payments or new cast hooks.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Persistent payloads,concentration,reciprocal reflectors and already-reflected/copy-derived roots need finite ownership.
originalQuestions.options: A: one explicitly authorized reflected branch per original applicable event with a consumed causal marker; two reflectors terminate according to a stated rule. B: a bounded different routing model with full proof of termination.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on actual terminal fate of the return,not just a loop-rejection guard that restores the initial harmful hit. Specify who maintains a returned persistent spell,which original deadline remains,whose endings remove it and how repeated genuine pulses differ from duplicated callbacks. Existing feat/class redirection caps are scoped comparison,not automatic authority for all rank9 spells. Reflection and post-defense damage-sharing are different operations; retain each real damage root without duplicate Wounds/drain/procs.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: End ALL MAGICAL EFFECTS in60ft radius,NO SAVE; CoreAction/range60/Instantaneous.
originalQuestions.options: A: a perceived center within60ft with a60ft-radius3D snapshot and center line of effect. B: caster-centered wave or different explicitly justified origin.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A as new geometry,including allies and own ongoing effects; no after-result selective omission. Identify attached bodies/items,freestanding fields,partially intersecting objects and independent applications before endings. Whole-body overlap and indivisible-effect selection must be stated; never add effects revealed when a captured wall disappears. Preserve no save and actual ending,not a temporary suppression field.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: All magical effects is broader than GreaterDispel,whose exact source excludes permanent enchantments/class engines and requires high-rank checks.
originalQuestions.options: A: end actual ongoing magical components including permanent enchantments where they are continuing effects,with a full explicit component taxonomy. B: narrow the source to eligible dispellable spells only as an acknowledged substantive departure.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer rather than silently importing lower-rank limits,checks or artifact exemptions. Establish native ordinary/class spells,summon animation,forms,curses,magic-item enhancements,innate magical capabilities and explicit nondispellable-source conflict. No-save is not permission to invent a contested dispel check. If a component is ended permanently,retain its mundane item/body/history and any source-qualified repair/recreation requirements. A magical creature identity or intrinsic class entitlement is not automatically an ongoing spell record to delete.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Many simultaneous removals can suppress the wave,remove shields,release bodies and trigger mandatory endings.
originalQuestions.options: A: immutable admission and eligibility snapshot followed by deterministic source-owned cleanup. B: another precise operation order that still resolves the complete captured set without outcome-dependent recapture.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A using existing order only where actually applicable. A wave originating or passing through operative LesserAntimagic retains its accepted interception rules unless this rank9 source explicitly gains a new bypass; ending a blocker cannot retroactively unsuppress the same incoming component. Record why captured enduring effects end or remain. Paid costs,finished teleportation,spent corpses,restoredHP and independent material changes are not rolled back. Summons/forms/tempHP/barriers use actual lifecycle/placement endings; no loot,refund,corpse or reflected-trigger duplication.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Abjuration:100ft radius where magic functions only as YOU PERMIT,CoreInstantaneous. Transmutation:NULLIFIES ALL TRANSMUTATION in100ft for1minute.
originalQuestions.options: A: one identity with two explicitly selected modes retaining both promises. B: one combined one-minute effect with a precisely reconciled permission versus transmutation rule. C: justified distinct variants without inventing access.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Director must choose. The broader permission version must not disappear into transmutation-only suppression. Conversely permitted Transmutation cannot silently negate the second placement without a selected mode/precedence policy. Preserve actual Abjuration class routes; printed secondary school is evidence,not automatic new repertoire. The owner TrueSeeing continuity choice is scoped,not a global rule forcing every multi-school source into one implementation.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: 100ft radius and Core100ft range are distinct; broad version has no complete duration/concentration or permission-edit clock.
originalQuestions.options: A: fixed center within100ft,100ft radius,one-minute field with an explicitly chosen concentration policy and predeclared permissions. B: following field or different complete duration/control procedure.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a stated finite policy consistent with the printed minute; select rather than assume concentration. Define permission grammar over source-owned magic,casters,applications and schools; allow/deny defaults and mutation Action/timing must be explicit. No unseen spell list,identity/faction revelation or arbitrary choices after hidden outcomes. Owner unconsciousness,departure,death and scene unload have exact consequences,not a hidden automatic permission reset.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Functions only as permitted and nullifies leave suppression versus permanent ending and cross-boundary magic unresolved.
originalQuestions.options: A: scoped ongoing suppression of nonpermitted expressions with clocks and original state retained. B: actual source-ending effects with separately justified permanence.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A for a live one-minute field but keep the full broad eligible magic set. Explicitly select item/class/innate/summon/form scope and actual-school classification for multi-school effects. Apply origin/path/intersection gates,remote concentration and persistent area rules without inventing global school membership from appearance. Denial does not erase prior ordinary actions or saved world history; resumption never refunds costs,replays missed pulses or repairs real harm. Transmutation-born permanent matter and ongoing transformed bodies are distinct.

originalQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Overlapping opposite permissions,self-suppression and other antimagic/ward absolutes can cause oscillation or contradictory authorization.
originalQuestions.options: A: denied expressions remain denied by any independently operative relevant field; explicit same-family self-maintenance exemption and deterministic source-specific precedence. B: a justified strongest/first-owner policy with complete tie and suppression cases.
originalQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on any exemption; LesserAntimagic same-family union is only a comparison. Anchors cannot bootstrap permission through a field that already prevents their own creation unless newly authorized. Mutually overlapping permissions do not manufacture cast slots or resource recovery. Test owner-specific competing fields,Prismatic/Eternal wards and NullificationWave with finite state transitions; retain each surviving source and its deadline rather than deleting losing histories.
